title: Tangent Line to a Square-Root Curve
change: ln x at x=e -> sqrt x at x=9; slope 1/(2 sqrt x)

title: Tangent Line to a Product Curve
change: ln x -> x e^x (product rule makes the slope a step); tangent at x=1

title: Tangent Line to a Reciprocal Curve
change: ln x -> 1/x; negative power rule; tangent at x=2

title: Limit Form of the Derivative of a Cubic
change: f at 3 -> x^3 at 2; h-form with explicit function

title: Limit Form of the Derivative of a Reciprocal
change: x->a form (not h form); reciprocal function; point 4

title: Instantaneous Rate as a Limit
change: adds a rate-of-change context; h-form; quadratic

title: Derivative of a Logarithmic Product at e
change: x^2 e^x -> x^3 ln x; evaluation at e; second term is x^2 not a derivative of e^x

title: Derivative of a Trigonometric Product at Pi
change: x^2 e^x -> (x^2+1) sin x; evaluation at pi (trig values)

title: Derivative of a Polynomial-Exponential Product at 2
change: x^2 e^x -> (x^2-3) e^x at 2; the polynomial factor gives a nonzero value that the exponential-only distractor exposes

title: Product of Cosecant and Cotangent
change: sec x tan x -> csc x cot x (every derivative is negative); same factored-form choices

title: Power Times Secant
change: trig x trig -> power x sec; common factor x sec x

title: Power Times Cosine
change: trig x trig -> power x cosine; two-term answer, no common factor

title: Absolute Value at a Corner
change: general statement -> a specific function with a corner

title: Piecewise Function That Joins Smoothly
change: adds a piecewise definition that is smooth at the join; reverses which statement is true

title: Piecewise Function With a Jump
change: adds a jump discontinuity; the true statement now uses the continuity-differentiability implication in the contrapositive

title: Damped Voltage Signal
change: e^(2x) sin x -> e^(-4x) cos x; negative chain factor and the cosine sign both matter

title: Power Times a Sine of 3x
change: exponential-with-chain factor -> sine-with-chain factor; polynomial first factor

title: Linear Factor Times a Gaussian Exponential
change: chain factor becomes a quadratic exponent; the product rule mistakes look different from the seed

title: Radical of a Quadratic
change: 1+x^3 -> x^2-6x+10; the 2 in the inner derivative cancels the 1/2

title: Reciprocal of a Radical
change: radical -> reciprocal radical; negative fractional exponent; inner derivative 2

title: Power of a Quadratic
change: radical -> an integer power; the same chain rule, a different outer function

title: Slope on a Cubic Curve
change: x^2+xy+y^2=7 -> x^3+y^3=9; no product rule, power-of-y chain factor is the crux

title: Slope on a Curve With an xy Term
change: xy term differentiated by the product rule; quadratic in y; different point values

title: Slope on a Curve With x²y
change: x^2 y term needs the product rule with the chain factor on y; the 'y is constant' distractor targets it

title: Slope on a Shifted Circle
change: circle centered at the origin -> shifted center; the shift must be carried into the ratio

title: Slope on an Ellipse
change: circle -> ellipse with a coefficient; the coefficient survives into the slope

title: Derivative of a Cosine of a Quadratic
change: sin(x^2) -> cos(3x^2); the outer derivative has a negative sign and the inner has a coefficient

title: Derivative of an Exponential of a Sine
change: polynomial inner function -> trigonometric inner function; exponential outer function

title: Derivative of a Natural Log of a Quadratic
change: sine outer -> natural log outer; reciprocal outer derivative
